items.title: Carney Woos Investors on Deals for Data Centers, Mines and LNG
items.summary: Canada plans to show some of the world’s biggest investors a pitchbook laying out tens of billions of dollars worth of projects spanning data centers, advanced manufacturing, liquefied natural gas, ports and dozens of mines.
